offering_description.value: Manufactures roofing systems, insulation and weatherproofing materials for commercial and residential construction. It sells through building-material distributors and retail channels, and directly to some contractors and industrial customers.

primary_products.value: Single-ply roofing membranes; rigid and spray foam insulation; roof edge metal and flashing; waterproofing membranes and air barriers; coatings, adhesives and sealants

customer_segment.value: B2B: Building-material distributors, roofing and insulation contractors, builders, home improvement retailers and industrial manufacturers; B2C: Homeowners buying roof repair and weatherproofing products through retailers

end_markets.value: Commercial construction and reroofing; residential construction and remodeling; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Roofing systems, insulation, waterproofing materials and related building products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts polymers, chemicals and metals into building materials for distributors, contractors and retailers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with operations in Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Commercial roofing systems, insulation, waterproofing, air barriers and other building envelope materials

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Roofing and specialty building-material distributors; direct sales: Selected contractors, applicators and industrial customers; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives serving commercial roofing markets; third-party retail: Home improvement retailers carrying roof repair and weatherproofing products
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; agents / brokers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and OSHA rules govern manufacturing, and roofing assemblies must meet applicable building and fire codes.
